notes.title: Demo Update 0.3.1
notes.content: [h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Bow Anvils[/b] would change to [b]Sword Anvils[/b] when it's reloaded[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemies could remain frozen (visually) if killed while under the effect of a [b]Freeze Bomb[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Freeze Bomb[/b] did not work correctly on animals[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where weapons could be transferred to inactive [b]Weapon Slots[/b] when moved from a [b]Repair Anvil [/b]using the quick transfer option (double clicking on the weapon)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sometimes certain weapons cannot be refreshed in any shop tables[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a dungeon room generation issue that caused incorrect tiles to appear along room edges[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Improvements[/h1][list][*][p]Improved animal behavior[/p][/*][*][p]Improved structure loading to prevent placed structures from disappearing when the game loads[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]This update brings some quality of life improvements, dungeon/farming adjustments, and bug fixes. Inventory management is now smoother and easier, dungeon rewards have been adjusted, and farming interactions feel more polished. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h1]Quality of Life[/h1][list][*][p]Added an option to [b]quickly move items via double click[/b]. Double clicking now transfers items as the follow:[/p][list][*][p]Main Inventory -> Chest[/p][/*][*][p]Main Inventory -> Shop Sell[/p][/*][*][p]Main Inventory -> Hot Bar[/p][/*][*][p]Hot Bar -> Chest[/p][/*][*][p]Hot Bar -> Shop[/p][/*][*][p]Hot Bar -> Main Inventory[/p][/*][*][p]Hot Bar -> Repair[/p][/*][*][p]Chest-> Hot Bar (if Hot Bar is full, then the item will be moved to Main Inventory)[/p][/*][*][p]Shop -> Hot Bar (if Hot Bar is full, then the item will be moved to Main Inventory)[/p][/*][*][p]Repair Anvil -> Weapon Bar[/p][/*][*][p]Repair Anvil -> Hot Bar (if Hot Bar is full, then the item will be moved to Main Inventory)[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Bar -> Repair Anvil[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Bar -> Hot Bar (if Hot Bar is full, then the item will be moved to Main Inventory)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Items can now be stacked and swapped between [b]Shop and the inventory[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Dungeon[/h1][list][*][p]Added a reroll option when selecting buffs[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]Elite Rooms mini map icons[/b], which are now optional (up until [b]Chamber 1-5[/b]). In other words, [b]Elite Rooms[/b] don't have to be cleared in order to progress to the next stage[/p][/*][*][p]Added additional purchasables to [b]Dungeon Shops[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Updated [b]dungeon chest rewards[/b][/p][list][*][p]Higher difficulty rooms now yield higher-tier chests[/p][/*][*][p]These chests contain increased Coin and Soul rewards[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adjusted layouts and balancing in some combat rooms[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Farming[/h1][list][*][p]Added new visual effects when interacting with Crops and Farm Lands, especially when working with multiple tiles[/p][/*][*][p][b]Water Cans[/b] can now be refilled at water sources around the enviroment instead of only at the [b]Water Hut[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Controller[/h1][list][*][p]Adjusted aim assist on some weapons/projectiles[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Shop[/b] sell prices did not update correctly when stacking, splitting, or dropping items[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual issue where [b]Tool[/b] and [b]Weapon[/b] durability bars reset to full length when closing the inventory[/p][list][*][p]Durability bars now display correctly whenever the [b]Main Inventory[/b] is opened[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a stacking audio issue when using high-tier [b]Water Cans[/b] or [b]Hoes[/b] on [b]Crops[/b] and [b]Farm Lands[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where weapon damage values displayed extra decimal points in the description panel[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain weapon idle animations stopped when durability reached 0[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Weapon Research Menu[/b] could remain active and not close after crafting[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Next Level teleporter[/b] could be interacted with when no subsequent level existed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where weapons appeared upside down when the player faced left while using a controller[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could cause the player to become stuck in an open menu[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for continuing to play. Every patch is a step toward a smoother and more enjoyable experience. Enjoy the new changes, and happy adventuring![/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2
notes.content: [p]Howdy everyone![/p][p]It’s been some time since the last update. This one brings improvements to [b]Aboveground[/b] exploration, full controller support, enviromental changes, and some quality-of-life changes, adjustments, and fixes. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][h1]Aboveground Update[/h1][list][*][p]Added a new [b]Village[/b] enviornment with additional resource spawn points[/p][list][*][p]The [b]Rogue NPC[/b] is now a permanent resident of the [b]Village[/b] with his own dedicated shop[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added day/night cycles[/p][list][*][p]Depending on the time of the day, player, object, and the enviorment will have visual changes[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added additional music tracks to [b]Aboveground[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Controller Support[/h1][list][*][p]The game now supports controllers without a keyboard and mouse[/p][/*][*][p]Interactable objects will be automatically targeted when the player is nearby. If multiple interactable objects are within range, the closest object will be prioritized[/p][/*][*][p]While using weapons in combat, the attack direction will automatically target the nearest enemy to the player. This auto-aim feature can be overriden at anytime using the right joystick[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Quality of Life[/h1][list][*][p]Higher tier [b]Water Cans[/b] and [b]Hoes[/b] can now affect a larger area of farmland[/p][list][*][p][b]Water Can[/b] and [b]Hoe[/b] descriptions are updated to reflect the area they can affect[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Add a [b]Quick Stack[/b] and a [b]Move All[/b] option to [b]Storage Chests[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Quick Stack[/b]: Move all matching items in the Inventory to the opened Storage Chest[/p][/*][*][p][b]Move All[/b]: Move all items in the Inventory to the Storage Chest. Matching items will be moved first[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Items picked up by the mouse will be automatically dropped when the inventory is closed[/p][/*][*][p]Updated [b]Crop[/b] growth logic. [b]Crops[/b] now can grop passively when the game is closed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Adjustments[/h1][list][*][p]Increased building placing speed[/p][list][*][p]Building should be placable when the input is held down rather than needing to repeatedly hit the place button[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Slightly increased [b]Crop[/b] growth time[/p][/*][*][p]Updated [b]Tool[/b] descriptions to reflect their rarity[/p][/*][*][p]Updated item stack count to 999[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some environmental objects to allow buildings to be placeable on the upper tile of a [b]Tree[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the materials required to unlock the waystone in [b]Grassland[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Other[/h1][list][*][p]Added an option to delete save file and backup files[/p][/*][*][p]Added a report option when the options menu is opened[/p][list][*][p]This option will required mouse & keyboard[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Fixes[/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that causes keybind to resets to "Any Key" when an going rebind operation is cancelled[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cancel key and existing keybind conflicting issue when rebinding keys[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sometimes keybinds cannot be be saved[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused weapon slot unable to be selected in some cases[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed save files can sometimes be overriden with an empty save file[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some resources (such as [b]Trees[/b] and [b]Ores[/b]) can spawn on top of [b]Berries[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that allowed [b]Buildings[/b] to be placed as soon as it's selected on the [b]Building Menu[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting the game![/p][p]Feedback is always appreciated and helps guide future improvements.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Aboveground Update[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Breakable Objects[/b] (Trees, Ores, Berries, etc.) now have independent spawn caps, increasing overall spawn rates
[*] [b]Coal[/b] and [b]Berry[/b] spawn rates are further increased to meet early-game stamina and smelting needs
[*] [b]Stone[/b] now spawns in [b]Grassland[/b] to speed up early progression
[*] Added animal encounters: 2 animals added in [b]Grassland[/b], 1 in [b]Mountain[/b]
[*] Added new fishing rewards
[/list]

[h1]Dungeon Update[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added an introduction helper to [b]Dungeon[/b]
[*] Added 5 new weapons and a multi-weapon system exclusive to dungeons
[*] Added 7 new enemies with new behaviors and projectile patterns
[*] Added 4 new utility buffs (selectable at the end of a dungeon stage)
[*] Added [b]Healing Pot[/b] (heal to full health) and [b]Research Table[/b] (dungeon weapon crafting) in [b]Chamber 1-1[/b]
[*] Added more weapons to treasure chests
[*] Updated dungeon combat room structures with further improvements in higher stage rooms
[*] Updated old enemy behaviors to include more projectile patterns
[*] Increased enemy density in higher stages
[*] Increased [b]Soul[/b] drops
[*] Rebalanced enemy stats
[*] Rebalanced dungeon room difficulty
[*] Improved [b]Titan Guard[/b] boss behaviors
[*] Adjusted buff selection at the end of each dungeon stage. [b]Stat Buffs[/b] are removed, they will be exclusive to enemy drops or shop purchases to increase the number of [b]Utility Buffs[/b] the player can receive
[*] [b]Destructible Objects[/b] (barrels, bookshelves, etc.) now drop items
[*] [b]Shop Rooms[/b] now includes a reroll option for item choices
[/list]

[h1]Save System Update[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a manual save button under [b]Options -> Gameplay[/b] (in [b]Aboveground[/b])
[*] Added a backup system that will automatically create a backup folder that saves up to 10 backups whenever the game exits or upon a manual save
[*] To prevent any save file issues (in case it happens), it is recommended to backing up your progress. To create backups manually with an older version, you can do this by creating a copy of your save file located here: [i]C:\Users\[YourName]\AppData\LocalLow\Chambers _ Crops\Chambers _ Crops\SaveFile[/i]
[*] If a save file is corrupted or lost, you can choose to load up a backup save through the "Backups" button in the main menu. The backup will automatically override the current save file
[/list]

[h1]Progression Update[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Buildings[/b], [b]Tools[/b], and [b]Weapons[/b] will be unlockable via progression
[*] [i]Note: most items are unlocked by default in the demo[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Other Adjustment[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added coin cost to [b]Nightmire[/b] & [b]Emberite Tools[/b]
[*] Increased (majority) item selling price
[*] Reduced [b]Mineral[/b] requirements for smelting Ingots
[*] Reduced [b]Stone Mineral[/b] required to craft [b]Stone Tools[/b]
[*] Reduced cooldown and increased invulnerability duration to player dodge (including Perfect Dodge)
[*] Dodge now check for potential damage instances instead of if the player has been damaged during the initial dodge grace period
[*] Melee weapons now break projectiles by default
[*] New visual effects added for [b]Thresher Blades[/b], [b]Broadswords[/b], and dungeon melee weapons
[/list]

[h1]Steam Achievement[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 14 basic [b]Steam Achievements[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Issue Fix[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed item loading errors in [b]Aboveground[/b] when items are left on the ground
[*] Fixed some items not being picked up when inventory slots were partially occupied
[*] Fixed items continuing to move toward the player after death
[*] Fixed [b]Storage Chests[/b] incorrectly dropping stored items upon destruction
[*] Fixed progression data failing to load when player data had errors
[*] Fixed melee weapons sending incorrect damage source to enemies
[*] Fixed [b]Destructible Objects[/b] (barrels, bookshelves, etc.) being destroyed multiple times per instance, causing excessive debris
[*] Fixed dungeon weapons not being removed correctly upon exiting the dungeon
[*] Fixed player buffs not being removed upon exiting the dungeon in certain scenarios
[*] Fixed [b]Titan Guard[/b] boss being killable multiple times in one encounter
[*] Fixed [b]Titan Guard[/b] boss getting stuck when losing its target during retreat
[*] Fixed [b]Titan Guard[/b] boss being immune to damage or stuck in an invisible state when frozen
[*] Balanced [b]Titan Guard[/b] boss damage intake to match other enemies
[*] Fixed errors when [b]Titan Guard[/b] boss is knocked back when its target is lost
[*] Fixed enemies becoming invisible when frozen
[*] Fixed enemies often get stuck when moving near obstacles
[*] Fixed enemies being pushed outside dungeon rooms and becoming stuck
[*] Fixed [b]UZI[/b] recoil animation stacking, causing the weapon to misalign
[/list]

[h1]Future Update[/h1]
The current progression in [b]Aboveground[/b] feels limited and repetitive, once a few tools are unlocked, there's pretty much nothing else to do. To address this, progression in [b]Aboveground[/b] is being expanded. Here’s a general overview of the plan:

[h3]Biome Overview[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Grassland[/b]: Basic materials to kickstart progression
[*] [b]Village[/b]: Social hub with NPCs, shops, and quests
[*] [b]Forest[/b]: More advanced wood materials, enemies, and environmental hazards
[*] [b]Mountain[/b]: Entry point for advanced crafting and building, limited Ores (Coal, Iron, rare Gold), and as an entrance to the Cave
[*] [b]Desert[/b]: Unique desert materials (cactus, bones as examples) plus enemies,structures, and events
[*] [b]Cave[/b]: Accessible through Mountain after certain quests. Features advanced Ores, deep procedural levels, andheavier combat mechanics
[/list]
[h3]Skill Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Combat[/b] skills will remain limited with some small adjustments if necessary while the other three ([b]Farming[/b], [b]Fishing[/b], [b]Mining[/b]) will see expanded options such as tool enancements, new item unlocks, and additional mechanics
[/list]
